about: Live chat eval (not CI): 20 questions against a real database, run with scripts/live_chat_eval.py. Expected values are checked against the filings: 'quality report' = the 10-K-as-filed spot check in docs/data-quality-2026-11-22.md; 'notes data set' = the SEC Financial Statement and Notes data set, the filing's own XBRL value for that accession, tag and period (checked 2026-11-23). Caterpillar segments join once C-06 lands.
